placeholderDescription: This module is under construction and will be available soon.
imagePromptPlaceholder: Describe an image for AI to generate
imageGenerateNoModel: The selected image provider has no image-generation models. In Settings pick an image provider that supports generation (OpenAI or Gemini), or use the online image search below.
imageSearchHint: Filter the library by name. Fuzzy matches part of the name, exact matches the whole name.
executorWebDesc: Manage content and tasks in the browser; execution runs locally by resource and queue.
executorDesktopDesc: Local browser, local file upload, image cache and video upload; publish at your pace.
executorEdgeDesc: Run supported tasks in your own Linux/Docker environment, with account binding and permissions per node.
publishEditingHint: Edit in the view above, then click Publish on the platform page. It closes automatically once published.
publishDiscardHint: Edit and publish each platform; it advances automatically.
publishDebugRecordHint: Persist the step log and screenshots to disk (artifacts/publish-logs); turn it on before the next run.
publishMultiHint: Select multiple platform accounts to publish to them all at once
publishEmptyAccounts: No accounts yet. Add and log in one first in Account Management.
publishRecordEmptyFiltered: No publish records match the current filters
vcUploadHint: MP4 / MOV / WebM / M4V, up to {size}
vcUnsupportedFormat: Unsupported video format. Use MP4, MOV, WebM or M4V.
vcTooLarge: This video is larger than the 5 GB limit.
vcDescriptionPlaceholder: Caption or description for the video (optional)
vcCoverNone: No cover selected. The platform will use the first frame.
vcPublished: Video submitted to the selected accounts.
vcEmptyLibrary: No video items yet. Upload one above to publish it.
vcHeaderHint: Pick accounts to fan out to multiple platforms at once
vcDistributeTitle: One piece of content, many platforms
vcDistributeDesc: Configure shared copy first, then override per-platform differences
vcVideoFormatHint: Supports MP4, MOV, MKV and more · up to {size} per file
vcVideoCluePlaceholder: Describe the actual footage or voiceover; the knowledge base only adds background and will not analyze this video.
vcPublicTitlePlaceholder: Enter a video title, or pick keywords and let AI draft it
vcPublicDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the video; adjust platform-specific copy and topics in Platform settings
vcBlankUsesPreset: Leave blank to use each account's video preset description; switching to a shared value drops the preset.
vcAccountIndependentDesc: Titles use each account preset by default; visibility, pinning and content declarations are saved per account and never change account defaults.
vcPlatformEmptyTitle: Pick publish accounts first, then configure platform settings
vcTopicsPlaceholder: Separate topics with spaces or commas
vcReviewDesc: Passing the pre-check does not mean platform approval. Below is the copy and visibility actually submitted for each account.
vcReviewNote: Accounts on the same platform may be split across tasks; if results differ, follow each account to avoid duplicate submissions.
vcPickerDesc: Only shows accounts that are signed in and authorized for video; filter by group, then batch-select.
vcVideoNoUpload: Videos are not uploaded to the business server
vcSummaryNote: Only the publish task is queued: videos are read by the executor and uploaded via each account's configured bridge egress.
vcReadyTitle: Prepare your video and publish accounts
vcReadyDesc: Each account runs independently; find results in Publish records
loginBrowserOpened: Browser opened. Log in in the Chrome window, then click Done.
loginIframeHint: Click in the preview below and type your credentials to log in. The session is saved locally (until it expires or is cleared).
loginTypeHint: Type text (first click the target input in the preview, then send)
riskHint: Checks every account headlessly: it opens the publishing page in the saved browser profile and reports whether a sign-in wall is showing. Nothing is clicked, typed or published.
riskAllHealthy: No account needs attention right now.
riskEmptyHint: Run a health check to verify the sign-in state of every account.
riskReasonSessionExpired: Recent failures look like an expired session
accountEmptyFiltered: No accounts match the current filters
addAccountPickPlatformHint: Choose a platform. A browser window opens so you can scan the QR code or sign in, and the account is saved automatically.
addAccountWaiting: Waiting for sign-in to complete… ({seconds}s left)
addAccountBrowserHint: Complete the sign-in in the opened browser window. When it is done, the account is saved and this dialog closes automatically.
addAccountTimeout: Sign-in timed out. The account is saved as "login required".
accountGroupManageHint: Rename a group to update every account in it, or delete it to ungroup them.
cmsPairingBody: A pairing code can be used only once and stays valid for 10 minutes. The connection token is stored encrypted — no database backup or admin password is required. The site also counts toward your account quota, while CMS publishing uses a separate daily allowance; each successful write (draft included) counts once per site.
usageCardNote: Only successfully generated articles are counted. Token usage is tracked separately; the figures above reflect the full successful-call totals.
usageTableNote: Only successful generations are counted. Click the highlighted header to change the sort order.
dashboardDescription: Quickly review sites, content, runs, and schedules.
siteAddDialogHint: Only the site name and platform are required.
sitePlatformUrlHint: Changing the platform fills its standard website URL. You can edit the URL before creating the site.
sitesSidebarHint: Use @ in chat to tell the agent which site to control.
siteTakeoverHint: Take over Chrome on the right. This app does not store passwords.
noActiveBrowser: Choose a site and open Browser to stream Chrome here.
browserWaiting: Browser is ready, waiting for preview frames...
browserClosed: Browser is closed. Open Chrome to continue.
browserOpenedNotice: Browser tab opened. Use the right panel to take over login or watch agent actions.
error_AI_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INVALID: AI provider returned invalid structured output
error_MODEL_GATEWAY_MISSING_COOKIE: Model gateway session cookie is missing
error_VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Video exceeds the 5 GB size limit
error_MODEL_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED: No adapter implements this protocol yet
error_MODEL_CREDENTIAL_MISSING: No credential is stored for this model endpoint
error_MODEL_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: Every stored key is unavailable (cooling down or rejected)
error_MODEL_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: The provider rejected this API key
error_MODEL_CREDENTIAL_FORBIDDEN: The provider refused this API key (permission or region)
error_MODEL_RATE_LIMITED: The provider rate-limited this API key
error_MODEL_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: No usable model provides the required capability
error_MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No model is configured for this request
allSitesOverflow: {hidden} more sites are hidden by this grid layout.
finalPublishApprovalBody: This run is configured to click the final publish button. Confirm here before queueing it.
finalPublishApprovalCheckbox: I approve this run to publish live content.
autoPublishLabel: Allow local runtime to click final publish/submit buttons
autoPublishHint: Default is off. Browser drafting, navigation, typing, and screenshots can run locally; final publish remains guarded unless this is enabled.
modelListHint: Model options are fetched from the provider API and cached briefly.
aiRegistryDescription: Every model the runtime knows about, grouped by provider, with the capabilities it provides and the source of that claim. Only callable models are routed to.
aiRegistrySyncHint: Pick a provider, then sync to pull its live catalog. Your endpoints, enabled models and probed capabilities are kept.
aiRegistryEmpty: No model matches the current filters.
aiRegistrySetDefault: The router uses these first. Setting a default also enables that model.
aiRegistrySources: The letter on each chip shows where the capability came from - vendor metadata, local catalog rules, a probe or your own override.
aiProvidersDescription: A provider is a vendor with one callable endpoint. The key lives in the local credential vault - the database only keeps its reference.
aiProvidersApiKeyHint: One key per line (commas work too) - calls rotate through them and cool a key down after a 429. Stored encrypted on this machine; leave empty to keep the current keys.
aiProvidersKeyResetDone: Key reset - it is back in rotation
aiProvidersKeychainUnavailable: The OS keychain backend is not wired up yet, so keys are stored as an AES-256-GCM file inside the app data directory. That protects against accidental sharing, not against a local attacker.
modelMgmtSubtitle: Model versions served by the model gateway, grouped by vendor and capability. Click a model name to copy its id.
modelMgmtEmpty: No models match the current filters.
modelMgmtCopyFailed: The clipboard is blocked. Copy it manually: {model}
modelMgmtCompatibleBaseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL for this vendor (click to copy)
modelMgmtCatalogNote: Imported from {source} on {date}: {total} models grouped by vendor and capability. Re-import with scripts/import-gateway-models.ts, and point the local provider endpoint at any vendor in the Model Configuration tab.
modelGatewaySyncDescription: Pull the live model list from your own gateway account. Off by default: while it is off, the catalog below serves the bundled snapshot.
modelGatewaySyncEndpointHint: The endpoint must answer with a JSON list of model ids.
modelGatewaySyncCookiePlaceholder: Paste the Cookie header value of a logged-in session
modelGatewaySyncCookieHint: The cookie is sent to the endpoint above only and stays on this machine in .env.local next to your provider keys - never in the database, the logs or the repository.
modelGatewaySyncReset: Clear credential and restore bundled list
modelGatewaySyncSaved: Settings saved. {count} models are now served from {source}.
modelGatewaySyncResetDone: Credential cleared. The bundled snapshot is active again ({count} models).
modelGatewaySyncDisabledHint: Turn the switch on to store your own cookie and sync the model list.
modelMgmtLocalDescription: Keys, endpoints and models used when the agent runs locally. The same settings are shared with System settings - Runtime.
modelMgmtProviderStatusDescription: Providers this app can call right now and the endpoint each one points at.
backupExportHint: Exports every local table into a single JSON file. Data stays on this device — nothing is uploaded.
backupMediaHint: Browser profiles, images, videos and artifacts live in the data folder and are not part of the JSON backup. Copy that folder as well when you move to another machine.
backupRestoreHint: Pick a backup JSON exported by this app. The format is validated before anything is written, so a bad file cannot damage the local data.
backupRestoreModeReplaceHint: Clears the tables contained in the file, then imports them: the workspace becomes an exact copy of the backup.
backupRestoreModeMergeHint: Keeps existing rows and skips records whose id already exists.
backupRestoreWarning: Restoring changes local data. Export a fresh backup first.
backupRestoreUnknownTables: Skipped tables unknown to this version: {tables}
backupErrorInvalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
backupErrorInvalidDocument: This file is not a CoolPilot backup.
backupErrorUnsupportedVersion: This backup was written by a newer version of the app.
backupErrorTooLarge: Backup file is too large to restore.
brandSettingsDescription: Saved brand details are appended to every local agent model request. Empty fields are omitted.
brandLogoHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Maximum 5 MB.
promptSettingsDescription: This prompt affects the local agent only. A custom value replaces the default behavior prompt while required execution rules remain enforced.
promptCustomActive: The custom prompt is active for new local agent requests.
promptUsingDefault: The built-in default prompt is active.
permissionHint: Choose which local agent operations can run without pausing for confirmation.
agentChatDescription: Use @ to target a site. Messages and tool calls are saved in local SQLite.
agentNoBrowser: Chrome is not running yet. Mention @site and ask the agent to use the browser.
agentEmptyState: Ask anything to start chatting with the AI.
chatDisclaimer: The AI can make mistakes. Please verify important information.
agentMissingSite: Type @ and choose a site before the agent controls the browser.
agentLoginRequired: This site needs manual login. Take over Chrome on the right.
schedulePostApprovalRequired: Approval is required before creating this scheduled post.
schedulePostMissingContent: Create a post in this chat before scheduling ‘that’.
schedulePostCreateFailed: Failed to create the scheduled post.
schedulePostInvalidTime: Include a valid time such as 9pm.
schedulePostInvalidDate: Include a future one-time date such as tomorrow.
schedulePostAmbiguousAccount: More than one Threads account matches. Select the account with @.
schedulePostMissingAccount: I could not identify one saved Threads account. Include its name or select it with @.
schedulePostMissingProfile: The selected Threads account has no browser profile.
posAiBannerTitle: Describe your account in one sentence and AI drafts the whole writer profile
posAiBannerDesc: Covers positioning, audience, content direction, system role, seed samples and writing guardrails.
posAiBannerNote: You review the draft before it replaces anything you are editing.
posAiPlaceholder: e.g. A funny news host who explains trending stories in punchy everyday language
posStoreBannerDesc: Submissions must pass the test-generation score (content quality + persona fit). After review it goes live for every user.
posStoreTaglinePlaceholder: e.g. Tech headlines, explained in one minute
posStoreSamplePlaceholder: Press Enter to add, e.g. cover the launch event
posStoreTestFail: Score too low. Fill in the intro, sample question and persona, then retry.
posFieldDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A home-cooking blogger focused on everyday recipes for beginners
posFieldTonePlaceholder: e.g. Professional but not stiff; warm and down to earth
posPersonaUpgradeTitle: Upgrade this positioning into a writer agent
posPersonaUpgradeDesc: Fill in the system role and seed samples below and this positioning becomes an agent that mimics your voice, plans topics on a schedule and drafts in your style.
posFieldPersonaRolePlaceholder: e.g. You are a cheerful home-cooking writer who explains every step in everyday language…
posFieldPersonaSeedsPlaceholder: Paste 2-3 published pieces, separated by a blank line
posFieldPersonaSeedsHint: Up to 3 samples, about 400 characters each
posFieldWritingGuidePlaceholder:
e.g.
1. Open with a real-life scene
2. Always cite the source of key data
3. Close with a follow prompt
posStrategyPreferenceHint: Blends the knowledge base with trending news and cites both.
posStrategyFreedomHint: No extra limits; allowed to add background knowledge on top of the references.
posStrategyKbReuseHint: Allow repeating knowledge base entries in new drafts
posPlatformHintDesc: Override tone, length, style and angle per platform. Empty means the global positioning is used. Priority: platform preset > AI plan > global positioning.
posPlatformAngle: Topic angle (injected into the platform prompt)
posPlatformAnglePlaceholder: e.g. lead with a personal story / use case / pitfalls checklist
posRssHintTitle: Add vertical RSS sources to this positioning
posRssHintDesc: Runs pick material from these sources; paste a URL and press Enter to add.
posRssPlaceholder: Paste an RSS URL and press Enter
posBindingEmpty: No account is bound to this positioning yet (pick a positioning for an account in Account Management).
appStoreSubtitle: Curated AI guides by domain. Each agent only does the job it was reviewed for.
appStoreEmptyMine: You have not published an agent yet. Configure a positioning and click “Publish to Store” to submit one.
kbEmpty: No knowledge entries yet. Add one with the buttons above.
kbFieldContentPlaceholder: Paste or type the knowledge body; it becomes a reference for AI writing
kbFieldTagsPlaceholder: Type and press Enter to add
kbSmartDesc: Paste any article, web page, note or chat log. The AI extracts the title, category and tags and structures it automatically.
kbUploadDrop: Click to choose a file or drop it here
kbUploadHint: Supports PDF / Word / Excel / TXT / Markdown, parsed into knowledge entries automatically
kbProductImportDesc: Export product details from Product management into knowledge entries in one click; the AI generates the summary, category and tags.
kbDifyBannerTitle: Dify supplies the material; writing still uses your configured AI model
kbDifyBannerDesc: References retrieved from the selected libraries are scoped by positioning. Checking sends the primary query and the matched document snippets to the Dify API. Do not connect libraries that contain internal pricing, customer privacy or other non-public material.
kbDifyEmpty: No external knowledge base connected yet. Your local knowledge base keeps working.
kbDifyApiBaseHint: Only public HTTPS addresses are accepted, e.g. https://your-dify.example/v1
kbDifyApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the knowledge base API key
kbDifyApiKeyHint: Use a knowledge base API key, not an app API key; prefer a key bound to the target library.
kbDifyFetchFailed: Could not fetch the library list. Check the address and key.
kbDifyNeedKeyForFetch: Enter the API key first to fetch the library list
kbDifyDatasetLabel: AI knowledge bases usable for creation
kbDifyDatasetHint: Up to 4. If listing fails, paste knowledge base IDs directly and press Enter; a check runs after saving.
kbDifyDatasetPlaceholder: Select or paste knowledge base IDs
kbDifyPublicConfirm: I confirm the material in the selected libraries may be used for public content.
kbDifyPositionPlaceholder: Leave empty (all positionings of this user)
kbDifyPositionHint: Empty applies to all positionings of this user; once specified, other and unbound positionings will not call it.
kbDifyInsufficientKnowledgeFirst: Knowledge first: stop generating and retry after adding material (recommended)
kbDifyInsufficientReferenceOnly: Reference only: state the gap clearly, do not generate or offer a fallback
kbDifyScoreHint: The score is a retrieval match score; the result depends on how well the question matches the library.
kbDifyNeedApiBase: Enter a valid HTTPS API address
kbDifyNeedKey: Enter the knowledge base API key
pdSearchPlaceholder: Search by product name / brand / keyword
pdEmpty: No products yet. Click “New product” in the top right to add one.
pdImageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Maximum 5 MB.
awSubtitle: Hot topics / products / custom → generate real content and save it to the library
awSearchHint: Search hot topics across platforms; click a title to multi-select
awHotEmpty: No hot topics found. Try refreshing.
awPlatformUnavailable: This source is not available right now.
awProductEmpty: No products yet. Add products in Product management first.
awProductSelectHint: Select one or more products as the material
awFreePlaceholder: Describe the topic direction, or paste your own content
awStyleAdvertorialHint: Weave the brand message into a natural recommendation
awStyleAdvertorialTemplate: Pain point → analysis → solution → results → call to action
awStyleReviewTemplate: First impression → specs & experience → pros and cons → who it suits → buying advice
awStyleRecommendTemplate: Real need → why I recommend it → hands-on details → checklist summary
awStyleScienceHint: Make a professional topic easy to understand
awStyleScienceTemplate: Phenomenon → how it works → common myths → practical tips
awStyleStoryHint: Drive the narrative with people and scenes
awStyleStoryTemplate: Character & scene → conflict → emotional turn → closing echo
awStyleBrandHint: Tell where the brand came from and what it stands for
awStyleBrandTemplate: Brand origin → key decisions → values → reader resonance
awPresetHint: Presets saved here can be loaded with one click next time.
awKnowledgeModeOff: Do not use the knowledge base
awKnowledgeInfo: Loads knowledge entries that match the positioning and scenario.
awAgentBanner: Uses the agent persona, tone, audience and knowledge base. The settings below can still be fine-tuned.
awCoreKeywordsPlaceholder: Keywords the title must contain, e.g. octopus, organic
awLanguageHint: Used for both the title and the body
awImageStrategyHint: Prefer product images when available, otherwise find or generate images
awImageCountHint: About one image per 400 characters (~3 for 1200 characters)
awDeAiHint: Applies a humanizer pass so the text reads more natural
arEmpty: No articles yet. Generate one with AI or create it manually.
arGenerated: Article “{title}” generated and saved to the library.
arFieldTitlePlaceholder: e.g. 5 things to check before buying an octopus
arFieldPostTextPlaceholder: Copy that can be posted as-is
arAiTopicPlaceholder: e.g. how to pick fresh octopus
arAiPromptPlaceholder: Extra requirements (angle, data to include, tone…)
aeAutoHint: Typesetting is on · formatted content is saved locally
aeBodyPlaceholder: Start writing, or generate a draft with AI first…
aeCoverHint: Not set. The first body image is used by default.
aiCompareHint: {count} changed paragraph(s) · the body is only replaced after you confirm
trLayoutStacked: Original first, translation at the end
rwDescription: This rewrite does not fetch extra knowledge; the original facts are preserved.
rwModePolishHint: Polish the language while keeping the original meaning
rwModePlatformHint: Adjust tone and structure to the target platform
rwModeRiskHint: Soften risky claims (academic / medical and similar)
rwModeToneHint: Change the style and only optimise the wording
rwStyleFeaturesPlaceholder: Paste 100-200 characters of your own writing so the AI matches your tone
rwTitleMustPlaceholder: Keywords the rewritten title must contain
rwCustomRequirementsPlaceholder:
One per line, e.g.
Keep first person
Reduce exclamation marks
trSource: Source language: Chinese · choose the target language
aimgSearchHint: Press Enter to search, or paste an image link or keyword
aimgUploadHint: Click or drag a local file here
aimgUploadSub: Inserted into the article automatically after upload
aimgSearchFailed: Image search failed. Please try again.
pcContentPlaceholder: Share something… (post body, supports multiple images)
mmAiPlaceholder: Enter a topic to generate a mind map
mmHintEdit: Double-click or press F2 to rename
mmHintMove: Drag a topic onto another to move it
mmHintMoveRoot: Drag the central topic to move the whole map
mmHintZoom: Scroll to zoom · drag the canvas to pan
metricsSubtitle: Aggregated content performance across connected platforms
metricsAutoRefreshHint: Off by default; manual sync only unless enabled
calendarSubtitle: Plan, review and schedule content in one monthly view
calendarAddForDay: Add a schedule for this day
calendarBestTimeHint: Ranked by average interactions per weekday and hour across your publish history
scheduleFieldMonthDaysHint: A day past a short month's length uses that month's last day
scheduleFieldTitlePlaceholder: Shown on the calendar, saved with the schedule
